name: Jesse Parakuo
tagline: Investigative journalist covering power, people, and the systems that connect them.
heroHeadline: Reporting on power, people, and the systems that connect them.
bioShort: Jesse Parakuo is a student journalist getting an early start — reporting from campus and community, building sources and bylines one story at a time, and already thinking like a newsroom professional.
bioLong: Jesse Parakuo is a student journalist who believes there is no such thing as too early to start. While completing his studies, he has been building a reporter's habits from day one: filing stories for the student press, covering campus and community beats, and treating every assignment — no matter how small — as a step towards the craft he wants to master.

His early work already reaches across the newsroom: his first investigations into how decisions are made, interview series with people shaping the future, and a growing photography and multimedia practice. He is learning the fundamentals — sourcing, verification, fairness, clarity — and enjoys the long, patient work of building trust with the people he writes about.

Jesse is determined to arrive in a newsroom with more than enthusiasm: with a body of work, a list of sources and the kind of discipline that only an early start builds. He is open to internships, work experience and freelance assignments, and would love to hear from editors who believe in giving young journalists a real chance.
responseNote: I read every message and aim to reply within two working days.
